operation.description: Deprecated: Use the QueryData method instead. Queries all the information stored about an account in the network. The returned account details may vary between calls, because an endpoint may route requests to different validators within the network and region, and the validators may not be at the same round ID at any given time.

operation.summary: Queries the network for information stored on the ledger, such as accounts and transactions.
operation.description: Queries the network for information stored on the ledger, such as accounts and transactions. Access to certain sensitive fields, such as account balances, may be restricted based on the identity of the sender derived from the signature in the request. If the sender lacks permission, sensitive fields will be redacted from the response and reported in the `redacted_fields` field.

operation.summary: Deprecated: Use the QueryData method instead.
operation.description: Deprecated: Use the QueryData method instead. Queries the state of a transaction. This method can be called for any transaction submitted to the network. The returned transaction details may vary between calls, because an endpoint may route requests to different validators within the network and region, and the validators may not be at the same round ID at any given time.

operation.summary: Submits an operational transaction to the network.
operation.description: Submits an operational transaction to the network. This method returns only after the transaction has been replicated across a majority of validators in the network, or if the transaction fails.

operation.summary: Submits a transaction to the network.
operation.description: Submits a transaction to the network. The request is first validated for basic correctness. If validation fails, the request will fail immediately. If validation succeeds, this method returns only after the transaction has been replicated across a majority of validators in the network, or until the request fails.
